candidates.change_summary: Change the conditional to require msg.value > MinDeposit (strict greater) so deposits equal to MinDeposit are rejected, altering balances updates.
Invert the deposit guard to require msg.value < MinDeposit so only smaller-than-minimum deposits are accepted, changing which calls update balances.
Remove the arithmetic overflow check require so balances update happens without that safety check; can change behavior when overflow/edge cases occur.
Swap the order: log the deposit before updating balances, so an external observer (Log) records a deposit even if balances update subsequently reverts (affects observable ordering/state).
Insert an early return when msg.value == 0 so zero-value calls do not get processed; changes balances update for zero-value deposits.
Change the updated mapping to use tx.origin instead of msg.sender, so the credited balance may be for a different address than the caller.
Change the log call to record a different value (0) so the log no longer reflects the deposited amount; balances still change but Log differs which may affect observers relying on log.
